annotations.title: Send an order or booking the AI receptionist made

description: Sends one order or booking the AI receptionist made and the number holds for a person to check first (state awaiting_send, its number set to ask_me_first), named by id. The customer gets it as a WhatsApp message with Confirm and Change, and it is done only when they tap Confirm. Refused in words when it was already sent, a newer one replaced it, a person has the chat, or the customer’s WhatsApp window closed. Each send needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve. The line it opens with was written by the AI and comes back marked untrusted.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.
